name: 2F-NENDCK
summary: 2F-NENDCK is a recreational designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, with dissociative effects presumably similar to those of ketamine. Its general effects, dissociative or otherwise, may deviate from other arylcyclohexylamines.

pharmacology.text: While not much is known about the drug's effects, anecdotal reports offer some insight into them.

uses.text: 2F-NENDCK (also known as CanKet, 2-fluoro-N-ethylnordeschloroketamine, 2'-fluoro-2-oxo-phenylcyclohexylethylamine, 2'-Fluoro-2-Oxo-PCE, and 2-FXE) is a recreational designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, with dissociative effects presumably similar to those of ketamine.

summaryZh: 2-FXE（別名：CanKet、2F-NENDCK）是一種娛樂策劃藥，具有芳基環己胺框架。它的解離效果推測與氯胺酮相似。2022年8月中旬，澳大利亞坎培拉的檢測機構首次發現了這種物質。它隨後在台灣、中國大陸和紐西蘭被陸續發現。
summaryZhHans: 2-FXE（别名：CanKet、2F-NENDCK）是一种娱乐策划药，具有芳基环己胺框架。它的解离效果推测与氯胺酮相似。2022年8月中旬，澳大利亚堪培拉的检测机构首次发现了这种物质。它随后在台湾、中国大陆和新西兰被陆续发现。
